data.name: Shothop
data.detailed_description:
SHOTHOP is a relentless retro inspired first-person shooter where precision platforming meets high-velocity combat. Use your shotgun to blast enemies and propel yourself through the air, chaining explosive jumps to keep your momentum alive.

You’re a portal hopper for a dystopian restoration crew. The defense network just went dead, isolating every sector across the cosmos. Your job? Drop in, find the displaced fuses, and force-reboot the portal junctions manually.

The problem? The heavy-metal maintenance robots have been hijacked. They control the sectors, they don't tire, and they’ve reclassified you as a system error that needs to be purged.

Cleanup. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

> Gameplay Overview

  • High-Speed Combat: Navigate levels at breakneck speeds. Momentum is your best defense.

  • Arsenal: Devastating shotgun and a high-caliber revolver.

  • Movement: Wall hopping, shotgun jumping, charging, sliding, and bunny hopping.

  • Beastiary: 15+ Robotic Enemies

  • Map Variety: Various Map Hazards, Powerups, and Secrets to Discover

  • Reboot the Grid: Every sector has a malfunctioning portal that needs repair.

  • Meet the Quota: Malfunctioning robots you destroy pays down the corporate debt.

  • Beat the Clock: Track your best map times.

  • Open Source SDK: Custom map support with Trenchbroom.

data.short_description: SHOTHOP is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 10-SERIES / AMD RX 500-series (Must Support Vulkan 1.0)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 30-SERIES / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Shothop contains fast-paced and intense combat against robotic enemies. Players will encounter frequent depictions of stylized violence such as mechanical destruction, oil spatters, explosions, and even sometimes light swearing. Blood may be depicted on screen when damaged.
